Counsel for Applicant :- Mohammad Farooque Ansari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.

Learned counsel for the applicants is permitted to correct the prayer clause during the course of
the day.

2. Heard Sri Mohd. Farooque Ansari, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Uday Bhan, learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. The instant application has been filed seeking quashing of the recovery certificate dated 22.7.2024 as well as the judgement and order dated 29.5.2024 in Case No. 1860 of 2023 (State vs. Mohd.
Maroof), under Section 51 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (hereinafter referred to "Act,
2006").
4.

sentences.text:
Per contra, learned A.G.A. states that the applicants have remedy to file an appeal against the order dated 29.5.2024.
6.

Considering the aforesaid submission and on perusal of the record, it appears that the order passed by the Additional District Magistrate (City), Moradabad, under Section 51 of the Act, 2006 is appealable order under Section 70(1) of the Act, 2006.
Therefore, applicants have a statutory remedy of filing appeal against the aforesaid order.
7. In view of the above, the application is dismissed with the liberty to the applicants to avail the aforesaid remedy by filing an appeal against the impugned order dated 29.5.2024.
